name: settings-rail-keys
description: the settings rail, driven by the keyboard alone. settings-tab-row proves the SAME selection move via a click and says in its own description why: at the time it was rewritten settings.js had no keydown handler, so an arrow key left both captures byte-identical (delta=0.00). This scenario is the other half - it sends no pointer input at all, so the only thing that can move the selected fill off General is the rail's keyboard path (railKey() in installSettings, plus the open-time focus() that puts the keyboard on the rail in the first place). If either regresses, nothing else on this surface can make the assertion pass.

actions.note: let the browser window finish first paint
Atrium MUST be frontmost or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings instead - observed, see settings-tab-row
open Settings; its menu item is not reachable from a scenario
window opens on General - renderSettings(root, PANES[0].id)
rail, General selected and holding focus

THE MEASUREMENT. No click, no Tab: the window must already have the keyboard on the rail for this to reach a '.settings-rail-item'. One step lands on Appearance, the same pane settings-tab-row reaches by clicking.
renderSettings() is a synchronous DOM rebuild, no CSS transition in settings.css - slack for the ssh/capture round trip, not an animation

assertions.desc: region re-measured 2026-08-17 against the TOP rail, the same correction settings-tab-row needed. The old region [85,81,207,29] was over the left column, where it reads delta=6.91 - under the threshold, while the pane behind it really does switch. This region covers the General pill alone (x=256-326, y=78-120). It must stay on ONE pill: pixcmp's delta is a euclidean distance between region MEANS, so a region spanning both General and Appearance cancels to delta=8.09. The 'down' key itself is still correct - RAIL_STEP in settings.js:1510 maps ArrowDown to +1, so it steps General to Appearance on the horizontal rail too.
Cmd+Q still quits with the settings window open
